data.name: Adityesh
data.gender_notes: Adityesh is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Adityesh is a name derived from Aditya, the Vedic name for the Sun God. The name Adityesh carries the meaning “Lord of the Sun” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Adityesh usually hope their child will grow to embody lord of the sun and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Adityesh total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

data.cultural_impact: Adityesh carries the legacy of the Sun God, Aditya, who is the primary deity in many Hindu traditions. The name evokes the idea of light, warmth, power, and energy, reminding us of the Sun's centrality in our lives.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Adityesh holds profound spiritual significance as it connects the bearer to Aditya, the ancient Sun God. This association represents the divine qualities of knowledge, strength, and illumination. Thus, carrying this name is believed to bestow upon the bearer a sense of divine guidance, protection, and enlightenment.

vedic_reference.note: From the Sanskrit word 'Aditya' meaning 'Sun' and 'Ish' meaning 'Lord'

historical_references.reference: Adityesh was an ancient Hindu name given to the sun god Aditya. It is composed of Aditya (sun god) and ish (lord or god). The name Adityesh is mentioned in various Hindu scriptures, including the Rigveda, which is one of the oldest known scriptures in the world, dating back to around 1500 BCE.

Another reference to Adityesh can be found in the Mahabharata, an epic Sanskrit poem consisting of over 100,000 verses. In this text, the name Adityesh is used to refer to Arjuna, one of the five Pandava brothers, who was considered a divine warrior and had the blessings of various gods including Aditya (the sun god).

modern_usage.modern_context: In today's interconnected world, the name Adityesh continues to be cherished by Hindu families globally. It is frequently featured on social media platforms where parents share their naming journeys, and Hindu name websites where expectant parents research meaningful names. The name bridges traditional Hindu values with modern Indian identity, making it relevant for contemporary families seeking names with deep spiritual and cultural significance.

name_in_real_life.story: Amit Adityesh from Kolkata, India embodies the meaning of Adityesh - "Lord of the Sun". Growing up in a Hindu family, they were taught to honor the spiritual significance of their name and live according to dharma.
